summary: How fast the model's file comes off its disk: one stretch of at most 64 MB, a third of the way in, read for at most 3 s. A second read of a stretch is the operating system's cache, not the disk - so the read goes past the cache where the platform allows it (`past_cache` true), says it cannot tell where it cannot (null), and says it is the cache when this server read that stretch before (false). `said` is the sentence. Refused while a model loads - the measure would measure the load as well - and while another measure runs.
